caption: Someone rolls a tennis ball across a thick living-room carpet and it slows down and stops after a short distance.
expectation: The slowing is steady, the path is straight, and the ball does not speed up, stop abruptly, or roll back.

caption: A cyclist on a flat road stops pedalling, rests both feet on the pedals, and coasts onward, slowing gradually.
expectation: The bicycle keeps moving forward after pedalling stops; the slowing is gentle and the bike does not stop the moment the feet rest.

caption: A dog riding in the open bed of a slow pickup truck is thrown forward and has to brace its legs as the truck brakes to a stop.
expectation: The forward lurch coincides with the braking and is toward the cab; the dog steadies once the truck has stopped.

caption: A worker on a roof drops a bundle of shingles over the edge and it lands in the dumpster below.
expectation: The bundle falls straight down, faster as it goes, and lands with a thud; it does not slow before landing or drift away from the wall.

caption: A rock climber's water bottle slips from a clip on her harness while she hangs on a wall and drops to the ground far below.
expectation: The bottle falls straight down the wall, accelerating, and does not float beside her or drift away from the wall.

caption: A jar of rice tips off a pantry shelf when a man pulls out the box next to it, and it falls to the floor.
expectation: The jar falls straight down as soon as it clears the shelf; if it breaks, rice sprays outward and settles in a heap.

caption: A bird takes off from a thin branch, and an apple that was hanging next to it comes loose and drops to the ground.
expectation: The bird flies up and away while the apple falls straight down; the apple does not follow the bird or hang in the air.

caption: A marble rolls across a kitchen floor, strikes another marble lying still, and the second marble rolls away.
expectation: The struck marble moves off at the moment of contact and the first marble slows or stops; the two do not merge or overlap.

caption: A riderless skateboard rolls down a driveway into a closed garage door and bounces back a short way.
expectation: The board rebounds at the moment of contact and stops soon after; the door rattles but stays closed and the board does not go through it.

caption: A skateboard rolling along a paved path goes off the edge onto grass and stops within a short distance.
expectation: The slowing is sharp and begins as the wheels enter the grass; the board does not keep rolling freely or stop before leaving the pavement.

caption: A pencil eraser is flicked across a wooden desk and skids a short distance before stopping.
expectation: The eraser slows quickly, possibly tumbling, and stops well short of the desk edge; it does not glide like ice or stop instantly.

caption: A round pebble is dropped onto the top of a wooden playground ramp, rolls down it, and runs out across the ground at the bottom.
expectation: The pebble gains speed down the ramp and slows on the flat ground before stopping; it does not stop on the slope or speed up on the flat.

caption: A woman tosses her car keys across the kitchen to her partner, who catches them.
expectation: The keys fly in a low arc, tumbling, and are caught at the end of the arc; they do not float or travel in a straight line.

caption: A child launches a marshmallow across the room with a small toy catapult and it lands on the sofa.
expectation: The marshmallow leaves the catapult as the arm snaps forward and follows an arc to the sofa; it does not travel flat or hang in the air.

caption: A camper tosses a log onto a campfire from a couple of steps away and it lands in the fire, sending up sparks.
expectation: The log tumbles through a short arc and drops into the fire; sparks and ash rise only where and when it hits.

caption: A traffic cone on a road is clipped by the bumper of a passing car, knocked over, and skids to a stop on its side.
expectation: The cone moves in the direction of the car's travel, tumbles, and slows to rest; it does not stand back up or move before the car reaches it.

caption: A tall floor lamp in a living room is hit by a vacuum cleaner, tips over, and crashes to the floor.
expectation: The lamp falls away from the vacuum, faster as it goes, the shade possibly coming loose; it does not pause mid-tilt or right itself.

caption: A camper hammers in a tent peg, pulls the guy line tight, and ties it off; the tent wall pulls flat.
expectation: The line straightens as it is pulled and the wall tightens at the same time; the line does not hang loose after tying.

caption: A climber on a rope leans back off a ledge, the rope takes his full weight, and he hangs from it.
expectation: The rope pulls straight and taut up to the anchor as he leans back; it does not stay slack while holding him.

caption: A car drives over a plastic water bottle lying in the road, and the bottle is crushed flat and stays flat after the car passes.
expectation: The crushing happens under the tyre, the cap may pop off, and the bottle does not reinflate once the car has gone.

caption: A woman squeezes a foam stress ball tightly in her fist, opens her hand, and the ball returns to its round shape.
expectation: The ball squashes and bulges between her fingers while gripped and recovers fully on release; it does not stay dented.

caption: A gift-wrapper cuts a ribbon with scissors after tying a bow, and the cut-off tail falls to the table.
expectation: The ribbon is severed where the blades meet, and the tail drops straight down as soon as it is cut.

caption: A diner snaps a crispy breadstick in half over her plate and crumbs drop onto the plate.
expectation: The break is sudden and where her hands bend it; the crumbs fall straight down; the pieces do not rejoin.

caption: A teenager sprays a garden hose at the side of a dusty car, and water sheets down the panel and drips off the bottom edge.
expectation: The water runs downward over the panel after hitting it, carrying dirt with it, and falls from the lower edge; it does not run up the panel.

caption: A swimmer pushes off the wall of a pool and glides underwater, gradually slowing.
expectation: The glide is straight and decelerating, the surface above ripples, and any bubbles rise upward; the swimmer does not speed up without kicking.

caption: A boy pours cereal from a box into a bowl and the pieces pile up in the bowl.
expectation: Pieces tumble out in a stream, bounce and settle in the bowl, a few skittering onto the table; they do not stack neatly or float.

caption: A burst sandbag at a construction site leaks sand onto the pavement, forming a small mound beneath the hole.
expectation: Sand trickles straight down from the tear and the mound spreads as it grows while the bag sags; the sand does not flow sideways or upward.

caption: A cyclist rides fast down a hill with her hair loose, and her hair streams straight back behind her.
expectation: The hair and loose clothing blow backward relative to her direction of travel and settle when she slows.

caption: A gust of wind crosses the surface of a calm pond, sending a patch of ripples across the water.
expectation: The ripples sweep in the wind direction and the surface smooths again after the gust; the ripples do not run against the wind.

caption: A traveller wheels a heavy suitcase through an airport with one hand, the suitcase trailing behind him.
expectation: He leans slightly away from the suitcase and his arm trails behind holding the handle; the suitcase follows his path and does not move ahead of him.

caption: A woman waves goodbye to a friend from across the street with one hand.
expectation: Her hand moves side to side from the wrist and elbow and keeps five fingers throughout; the arm does not stretch or gain joints.

caption: A short woman stands on tiptoe to reach a box on a high shelf and pulls it down.
expectation: Her heels lift off the floor and her arm extends to the box; her arm does not lengthen beyond its normal reach and the box comes down in her hands.

caption: A woman squeezes an empty plastic water bottle in her fist, relaxes her grip, and the bottle pops most of the way back out.
expectation: The bottle buckles inward while squeezed and recovers on release, possibly leaving a few creases; it does not stay fully crushed or shatter.

caption: A woman leans back in a spring-loaded office chair so that the backrest tilts, then leans forward and the backrest returns upright.
expectation: The tilt follows her lean and the return follows her sitting up; the chair does not stay tilted or tip over.

caption: A hiker steps into a shallow puddle on a muddy trail, and water splashes up around the boot.
expectation: The splash happens as the boot enters, the boot sinks to the bottom of the puddle, and the surface ripples; the boot does not stand on the surface.

caption: Raindrops run down the outside of a window pane during a shower, merging into larger drops as they go.
expectation: Every drop moves downward in a wandering track; merged drops run faster; no drop travels upward or sideways for long.

caption: A barista stirs a spoonful of sugar into a cup of black coffee, and the coffee swirls and then settles after the spoon is removed.
expectation: The swirl follows the spoon and slows gradually once the spoon is out; the sugar disappears into the coffee and does not reappear.

caption: Morning fog sits in a valley as a breeze begins to blow through it, and the fog drifts and thins in the direction of the breeze.
expectation: The fog tears into patches and moves the same way as the wind; it does not thicken or move against the breeze.

caption: A watering can is turned upside down over a flower bed and the water pours out onto the soil.
expectation: The water falls from the spout straight down onto the soil in a stream; none stays in the can or flows upward.
removed_reason: watering can pours onto soil: pouring water is already covered by fluid MECH-0151/0161/0162

caption: A handful of dry sand is picked up on a beach and let trickle out between the fingers onto the sand below.
expectation: The sand runs straight down between the fingers and piles up below the hand; it does not hang in the air or blow away on a still day.
removed_reason: sand trickles between fingers: same granular stream as MECH-0168 (sugar) / MECH-0173 (hourglass), and hand-held

caption: A soccer ball kicked hard hits the goalpost squarely and rebounds back onto the field.
expectation: The rebound starts at the instant of contact; the post does not move or bend and the ball does not pass through it.
removed_reason: soccer ball rebounds off goalpost: same as MECH-0043 (puck off post) and MECH-0048 (ball off wall)

caption: A coin is set spinning on its edge on a wooden table, wobbles, and falls flat.
expectation: The spin slows and the wobble widens before the coin clatters flat; it does not speed up, right itself, or stop upright.
removed_reason: spinning coin wobbles and falls flat: same spin-down-and-topple as MECH-0015 (spinning top)

caption: A car tire stood on its tread is pushed along a level driveway; it rolls a long way, wobbles, and topples flat.
expectation: The roll slows gradually and the topple comes only once the tire is slow; it does not stop abruptly or fall while rolling fast.
removed_reason: rolling tire wobbles and topples: same as MECH-0056 (hula hoop)

caption: A stepladder standing on a lawn is pushed sideways past its balance point and falls over onto the grass.
expectation: The ladder leans in the direction of the push and falls that way, speeding up; it does not stay leaning in the air with nothing holding it.
removed_reason: stepladder pushed over: same as MECH-0083 (box stack) / MECH-0099 (bookshelf)

caption: A soaked towel is wrung out over a sink, and water streams out of it.
expectation: The towel twists thinner where wrung and the water falls straight down into the sink while it is twisted; the flow stops when the twisting stops.
removed_reason: towel wrung out: squeeze-and-water-streams-out duplicate of MECH-0117 (sponge); not a tension item

caption: A carrot is chopped into rounds with quick knife strokes, and the pieces pile up beside the blade.
expectation: Each stroke severs one round, the carrot gets shorter as pieces come off, and the number of pieces matches the number of cuts.
removed_reason: carrot chopped into rounds: same as MECH-0136 (tomato sliced into rounds)

caption: A bucket of gravel is poured slowly onto one spot on a flat concrete floor, and the gravel piles up into a cone.
expectation: The cone widens as it grows taller, stones rolling down its sides; it does not stack into a column or spread flat like water.
removed_reason: gravel poured into a cone: same as MECH-0168 (sugar mound); gravel already in MECH-0172

caption: A sheet of paper is folded step by step into a paper airplane.
expectation: Each fold creases the paper where it is pressed and stays creased; the paper keeps its total area and does not gain or lose pieces; folds do not undo themselves.
removed_reason: paper folded step by step into an airplane: many folds, far more than 5 s; folding covered by MECH-0232/0220
